10098-how-jerusalem-was-won-being-the-re.description: A book by W.T. Massey. In a war which involved the peoples of the four quarters of the globe it was to be expected that on the world's oldest battleground would be renewed the scenes of conflict of bygone ages.

arxiv-1610-03582.title: QCMA hardness of ground space connectivity for commuting Hamiltonians
arxiv-1610-03582.creator: David Gosset, Jenish C. Mehta, Thomas Vidick
arxiv-1610-03582.description: A 2016 arXiv research paper by David Gosset, Jenish C. Mehta, Thomas Vidick. In this work we consider the ground space connectivity problem for commuting local Hamiltonians. The ground space connectivity problem asks whether it is possible to go from one (efficiently preparable) state to another by applying a polynomial length sequence of 2-qubit unitaries while remaining at all times in a state with low energy for a given Hamiltonian H H .

arxiv-2106-07291.title: A Multi Polarization Square Patch Antenna with a Reconfigurable Feeding Network
arxiv-2106-07291.creator: Roozbeh Rezaeipour
arxiv-2106-07291.description: Abstract A multi-polarization square patch antenna with a reconfigurable feeding network is presented in this paper. The reconfigurable feeding network of this antenna is implemented on a FR-4 substrate by a Wilkinson power divider and a branch line coupler which perform amplitude distribution in the feeding network.

arxiv-2106-12819.title: Accelerating variational quantum algorithms with multiple quantum processors
arxiv-2106-12819.creator: Yuxuan Du, Yang Qian, Dacheng Tao
arxiv-2106-12819.description: Abstract Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) have the potential of utilizing near-term quantum machines to gain certain computational advantages over classical methods. Nevertheless, modern VQAs suffer from cumbersome computational overhead, hampered by the tradition of employing a solitary quantum processor to handle large-volume data.

arxiv-2110-12083.title: Carnegie Supernova Project-II: Near-infrared Spectroscopy of Stripped-Envelope Core-Collapse Supernovae This paper includes data gathered with the 6.5 meter Magellan Telescopes at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile. firehose ( Simcoe et al. 2013 ) , SNID ( Blondin & Tonry 2007 ) , SNooPy ( Burns et al.
arxiv-2110-12083.creator: M. Shahbandeh, E. Y. Hsiao, C. Ashall, J. Teffs, P. Hoeflich, N. Morrell, M. M. Phillips, J. P. Anderson, E. Baron, C. R. Burns, C. Contreras, S. Davis, T. R. Diamond, G. Folatelli, L. Galbany, C. Gall, S. Hachinger, S. Holmbo, E. Karamehmetoglu, M. M. Kasliwal, R. P. Kirshner, K. Krisciunas, S. Kum
arxiv-2110-12083.description: Abstract We present 75 near-infrared (NIR; 0.8 − - 2.5 μ \mu m) spectra of 34 stripped-envelope core-collapse supernovae (SESNe) obtained by the Carnegie Supernova Project-II (CSP-II), encompassing optical spectroscopic Types IIb, Ib, Ic, and Ic-BL. The spectra range in phase from pre-maximum to 80 days past maximum.

arxiv-2112-03599.title: Charged excitons or trions in 2D parabolic quantum dots?
arxiv-2112-03599.creator: Nguyen Hong Quang 1,2 and Nguyen Que Huong 3
arxiv-2112-03599.description: Abstract So far in the literature the terms “charged exciton” and “trion” are often confused with each other and mostly considered as the same. In this work we show this is not the case in 2D quantum dots with a parabolic confinement.

arxiv-2303-17477.title: On the Analysis of Computational Delays in Reinforcement Learning-based Rate Adaptation Algorithms
arxiv-2303-17477.creator: Ricardo Trancoso, Ruben Queiros, Helder Fontes, Rui Campos
arxiv-2303-17477.description: Abstract Several research works have applied Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms to solve the Rate Adaptation (RA) problem in Wi-Fi networks. The dynamic nature of the radio link requires the algorithms to be responsive to changes in link quality. Delays in the execution of the algorithm may be detrimental to its performance, which in turn may decrease network performance.

arxiv-2310-07380.title: Histopathological Image Classification and Vulnerability Analysis using Federated Learning
arxiv-2310-07380.creator: Sankalp Vyas, Amar Nath Patra, Raj Mani Shukla
arxiv-2310-07380.description: Abstract Healthcare is one of the foremost applications of machine learning (ML). Traditionally, ML models are trained by central servers, which aggregate data from various distributed devices to forecast the results for newly generated data. This is a major concern as models can access sensitive user information, which raises privacy concerns.

arxiv-2409-16185.title: Refactoring-aware Block Tracking in Commit History
arxiv-2409-16185.creator: Mohammed Tayeeb Hasan, Nikolaos Tsantalis, Pouria Alikhanifard
arxiv-2409-16185.description: Abstract Tracking statements in the commit history of a project is in many cases useful for supporting various software maintenance, comprehension, and evolution tasks. A high level of accuracy can facilitate the adoption of code tracking tools by developers and researchers. To this end, we propose CodeTracker, a refactoring-aware tool that can generate the commit change history for code blocks.

arxiv-2501-07810.title: AVS-Mamba: Exploring Temporal and Multi-modal Mamba for Audio-Visual Segmentation
arxiv-2501-07810.creator: Sitong Gong, Yunzhi Zhuge, Lu Zhang, Yifan Wang, Pingping Zhang, Lijun Wang, Huchuan Lu
arxiv-2501-07810.description: Abstract The essence of audio-visual segmentation (AVS) lies in locating and delineating sound-emitting objects within a video stream. While Transformer-based methods have shown promise, their handling of long-range dependencies struggles due to quadratic computational costs, presenting a bottleneck in complex scenarios.

arxiv-2507-08321.title: Yutaka Hosotani
arxiv-2507-08321.description: Abstract In the S ​ O ​ ( 5 ) × U ⁡ ( 1 ) × S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) SO(5)\times U(1)\times SU(3) gauge-Higgs unification in the Randall-Sundrum (RS) warped space neutrino oscillations and the Pontecorvo-Maki-Nakagawa-Sakata (PMNS) matrix in the W W couplings originate from Majorana mass terms on the ultraviolet brane in the RS space.

arxiv-2507-12920.title: MoCap2GT: A High-Precision Ground Truth Estimator for SLAM Benchmarking Based on Motion Capture and IMU Fusion
arxiv-2507-12920.creator: Zichao Shu, Shitao Bei, Jicheng Dai, Lijun Li, Zetao Chen
arxiv-2507-12920.description: Abstract Marker-based optical motion capture (MoCap) systems are widely used to provide ground truth (GT) trajectories for benchmarking SLAM algorithms. However, the accuracy of MoCap-based GT trajectories is mainly affected by two factors: spatiotemporal calibration errors between the MoCap system and the device under test (DUT), and inherent MoCap jitter.

pmc-10629661.title: Theta-band phase locking during encoding leads to coordinated entorhinal-hippocampal replay
pmc-10629661.creator: Diogo Santos-Pata, Caswell Barry, H Freyja Ólafsdóttir
pmc-10629661.description: SummaryPrecisely timed interactions between hippocampal and cortical neurons during replay epochs are thought to support learning. Indeed, research has shown that replay is associated with heightened hippocampal-cortical synchrony. Yet many caveats remain in our understanding. Namely, it remains unclear how this offline synchrony comes about, whether it is specific to particular behavioral states, and how—if at all—it relates to learning.

pmc-11507045.title: Unraveling the Mitogenomic Characteristics and Phylogenetic Implications of Leuciscus merzbacheri (Zugmayer, 1912), an Endangered Fish in the Junggar Basin of Xinjiang, Northwest China
pmc-11507045.creator: Yan Sun, Tianyan Yang
pmc-11507045.description: Background: Leuciscus merzbacheri is a rare and endangered fish in Xinjiang, China. As a representative species of the fauna in the Junggar Basin, it is of high economic and scientific value. The genetic data are still limited, and the mitochondrial genomic characteristics remain unexplored. Methods: A high-throughput sequencing method was used to obtain the complete mitogenome of L. merzbacheri.

pmc-11639980.title: A Global Regional Comparison of the Risk of Breast Cancer in Woman Using Oral Contraceptives—Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-11639980.creator: Agnieszka Drab, Krystian Wdowiak, Wiesław Kanadys, Maria Malm, Joanna Dolar-Szczasny, Grzegorz Zieliński, Mariola Borowska, Urszula Religioni
pmc-11639980.description: Simple SummaryOral Contraceptives (OCs) may play a role in the development of breast cancer. A meta-analysis was undertaken using a DerSimonian–Laird random effects model to investigate the association between OCs use and breast cancer (BrCa) risk by geographic region of the world. A systematic review was performed (MEDLINE, EMBASE, and the Cochrane Library) from1995 to 2023.

pmc-12409344.title: Capsid redirection mechanism of the Staphylococcus aureus pathogenicity island SaPIpT1028
pmc-12409344.creator: Adaeze Doris Ojiogu, Jonasz B Patkowski, Xu Kuang, Tiago R D Costa, Jakob T Rostøl, José R Penadés
pmc-12409344.description: Staphylococcus aureus pathogenicity islands (SaPIs) are prototypical members of the phage-inducible chromosomal islands (PICI) family. These elements redirect helper phage capsid assembly to produce smaller capsids, accommodating the satellite genome while excluding the phage genome. This study identifies how SaPIpT1028 mediates capsid redirection through a unique gene, rcm (redirecting capsid morphogenesis).

pmc-12459257.title: Jejunal lipoma presenting as small bowel intussusception in an adult: diagnostic and surgical challenges—a case report
pmc-12459257.creator: Midani Touati, Faiez Boughanmi, Hiba Ben Hassine, Hanene Zenati, Leith Limayem, Faouzi Noomen
pmc-12459257.description: Intussusception is a rare cause of adult small bowel obstruction, often associated with malignant lesions but occasionally caused by benign etiologies like lipomas. The clinical presentation is diverse, with symptoms ranging from abdominal pain to changes in bowel habits. Computed tomography plays a pivotal role in diagnosis.

pmc-12981255.title: The complete mitochondrial genome of Trirachys orientalis (Coleoptera: Cerambycidae)
pmc-12981255.creator: Xiaolei Song, Guoqing Wan, Fengzhu Zhang
pmc-12981255.description: Trirachys orientalis (Hope, 1841) is a long-horned beetle widely distributed in China with economic importance and potential medicinal value. In this study, we sequenced and assembled its complete mitochondrial genome. The complete mitogenome is 16,028 bp in length with a GC content of 29.60%, including 13 protein-coding genes, 2 ribosomal RNA genes, 22 transfer RNA genes, and a control region.

pmc-13213407.title: Outcomes for Early Years’ Children in Contact with Social Services in Northern Ireland: A Data Linkage Study Protocol
pmc-13213407.creator: Rachel Leonard, Lisa Bunting
pmc-13213407.description: IntroductionChildren’s social care involvement in the early years has significant implications for child development and family wellbeing. While previous research has highlighted associations between deprivation and child welfare interventions, there remains limited understanding of the timing, recurrence, and intergenerational patterns of social care contact. This study addresses these gaps using linked administrative data in Northern Ireland.

pmc-13500464.title: Viral syncytia evolve to resist interferon
pmc-13500464.creator: Tiansheng Li, Insung Kang, Juan Ye, Zhe Hu, James Gibbs, Chengjin Ye, Kazuyo Takeda, Ivan Kosik, Guoli Shi, Jaroslav Holly, Martina Kosikova, Zhiping Ye, Alex A. Compton, Luis Martinez-Sobrido, Reed F. Johnson, Hang Xie, Jonathan W. Yewdell
pmc-13500464.description: SARS-CoV-2, like many viruses, generates syncytia but the role of syncytia formation in viral evolution remains unknown. Using SARS-CoV-2 and SARS-CoV-2 Spike (S) replacement vesicular stomatitis (VSV), we show that S-mediated syncytia impair the antiviral effects of interferons in cultured cells, human lung cell cultures, and hACE2 transgenic mice.

pmc-13505702.title: Homo‐/Heterodimeric Substrates Bias the Type and Multiplicity of Hydroxamic Acid Chelators Assembled by a NIS Synthetase DesD
pmc-13505702.creator: Callum A Rosser, Todd E Markham, Rachel Codd
pmc-13505702.description: The siderophore synthetase DesD generates hydroxamic acid chelators with applications in metal‐based radiopharmaceuticals and sequestering toxic or commodity metals. DesD has been used in chemoenzymatic syntheses with native substrates, with less focus on non‐native substrates. This study investigated masking the modest activity of the non‐native substrate N‐hydroxy‐N‐glutarylcadaverine (2) by forming a heterodimer with the native DesD substrate N‐hydroxy‐N‐succinylcadaverine (1).

pmc-13526460.title: Delayed Heterogeneous Left Buttock Mass Following Gluteal Augmentation in a Young Symptomatic African American Woman: A Case Report
pmc-13526460.creator: Bom K Bong, Trevor Williams, Nazia Khaleel, Makeda Green, Frederick Tiesenga

pmc-13608331.title: A Prescription for Program Sustainability: The Drug-Free Community Sustainability Model in Practice
pmc-13608331.creator: Laura M. Mercer Kollar, Wendy Cummings, Christine Koffkey, Melody C. Reid, Dale Owens, Bianca Anderson, Taynel Albarran, Joanne P. Smith-Darden
pmc-13608331.description: Context:The Drug-Free Communities (DFC) Support Program awards federal grants for up to 10 years to community coalitions aimed at reducing youth substance use across the United States. This report describes efforts for program sustainability, shares sustainability examples from DFC-funded coalitions, and describes public health impact of coalition continuity of funding and activities beyond the DFC funding period.

pmc-13640366.title: Sirolimus to the rescue: rapid therapeutic response in kaposiform hemangioendothelioma - case report and literature overview
pmc-13640366.creator: Aleksandra Filipiuk, Łukasz Hutnik, Dominik Nguyen, Paweł Łaguna
pmc-13640366.description: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma (KHE) is a rare, locally aggressive vascular tumour of childhood. Due to its infiltrative growth and possible development of Kasabach-Merritt phenomenon (KMP) if untreated, early intervention is mandatory. Sirolimus, an mTOR (mammalian target of rapamycin) inhibitor, that has been used extensively in children following solid organ transplantation.
